headline: Pinac advises TagMango on joint venture with ClickFunnels to launch Backstage Pass
sum: TagMango and ClickFunnels have jointly launched Backstage Pass, a creator platform that brings together live streaming, AI-powered content tools and monetisation features. Pinac advised and assisted TagMango on the transaction.
detail: TagMango and ClickFunnels have jointly launched Backstage Pass, a creator platform that brings together live streaming, AI-powered content tools and monetisation features. Pinac advised and assisted TagMango on the transaction. The Firm’s role involved providing strategic advice and drafting and negotiating the transaction documents. The transaction was led by Utsav Lohia (Partner) and Eeshan Mohapatra (Senior Associate), with assistance on IP aspects from Raghu Vinayak Sinha (Of Counsel).
